prompts.01-light-balanced.png:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: polished native Android Hush home-screen mockup, grounded in the actual code.
Output: single flat straight-on portrait 9:20 full screen app screenshot, 412x915dp proportions, no device frame or outside labels. Precise crisp readable UI, native sans-serif, restrained typography, 20dp gutters, touch targets 48dp. Existing Hush brand rounded lowercase h and "Hush"; tagline verbatim "YouTube, with room to pause." Compact header with small h mark and wordmark on left, tiny tagline below, circular "P" profile switcher and overflow dots right. Android status bar "9:41", bottom gesture line.
CRITICAL BOTTOM BAR: preserve the current code structure exactly: scrolling content ABOVE a fixed bottom search dock. The dock has ONE 56dp-high modest tonal rounded field with small magnifier and ordinary 16sp placeholder "Search YouTube", plus separate 48-56dp circular incognito mask button. Search must be minimal, low contrast relative to the hero, not a large primary CTA, not a promotional banner. No search near the top, no duplicated search, no microphone, no bottom navigation tabs. Dock surface matches page, tiny hairline top separator, 8dp vertical padding, 20dp horizontal padding. 
Content: compact "Take a break" heading then a 128dp green card with a small 40dp breathing ring next to "A moment for yourself", small "Breathe or meditate", and two equal 48dp pills "Breathe" and "Meditate". 24dp below, "Quick games" section title and small right-aligned "All games" chevron. Two equal compact 110dp game cards: labels "2048" and "Snake", respective sublabels "Slide and combine" and "A quick chase"; each with tiny accurate game preview. Full width 64dp "Sudoku" row under them with miniature grid, subtitle "Challenge your mind", trailing chevron. 24dp below, "Your library" heading and ONE compact 76dp tray with three equal icon-and-label items "History", "Saved", "Downloads". Keep sections contained in upper two thirds of viewport, leave intentional blank space before bottom dock. No recommendation feed, recent content, invented counters, streaks or decorative scene illustrations. Cards use subtle fine borders; no excessive shadows, shiny buttons or gradients. All supplied labels spelled exactly.
Primary request: LIGHT resting home, warm paper #F6F3EB background, dark pine ink #1C2922, secondary ink #536257, break card flat pine #24483D, cream Breathe and muted sage Meditate buttons. Game surfaces and library tray warm stone #EEEAE1. Bottom search field is pale sage #E7EEE5 with subtle #C7D1C7 outline, dark pine magnifier and text, incognito same pale tone. It is a quiet utility bar, less visually prominent than Take a break. No playback row in this state. Elegant balanced density: header 60dp, break section 162dp, game section 224dp, library section 112dp, generous gaps, fixed dock about 80dp. Smooth corner radii 16-20dp, avoid enormous headers or enormous game previews.
